_preregistered: 2026-09-01. Fixed BEFORE any model was trained or evaluated. Every listed model is reported in the paper regardless of its metric behaviour; none are dropped or added post hoc.
_epochs_placeholder: EPOCHS is substituted by train_zoo.py from --epochs; short/vshort are fractions of it.

_axes.seed: independent draws of the same recipe -> lower bound on checkpoint-to-checkpoint variation
_axes.capacity: encoder depth/width and predictor depth -> quality spectrum from architecture
_axes.budget: epochs and data fraction -> quality spectrum from optimisation
_axes.regularisation: SIGReg weight, incl. lam=0 which risks representation collapse
_axes.memory: ctx_len sweep 1,2,3,5,8 -> the trained Mem-Ctrl axis K3 needs

_memory_axis_batch: The mem* models share batch 20 and half the epoch budget, including their own ctx=3 point, because SIGReg is a batch statistic (it scales by proj.size(-2)): letting batch vary with ctx_len would confound memory capacity with regularisation strength. Larger ctx_len encodes more frames per sample, so batch 56 OOMs at ctx>=5 given the ~8 GB per card left by other tenants on this node. The sweep only needs to be internally comparable (it answers K3); the base_* models carry the reference budget.
_order: Listed longest-running first so the scheduler starts mem8/mem5 in the first wave. Order affects scheduling only, never which models are reported.
